text: He carries the wood, and he asks about the lamb, and the answer he receives is no answer at all. Of his mind the writer gives nothing; there is only a verb, they went, both of them, together. The phrase recurs. Repetition is made to stand where an explanation should be, and the question of his consent, once it has been raised, is quietly laid aside. Obedience, in Isaac, leaves nothing over; they went, both of them, together.
